# ADR-3243: AWS s3: Public-read canned ACL in SDK put for object 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

SDK canned ACLs bypass infrastructure intent.

## Decision

Application code SHALL NOT use a public-read canned ACL in SDK put for object 3 (AWS-s3-3).

## Consequences

Object ownership enforces bucket owner enforced.
